gaps.sentence: Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
During the tour she pointed ___ the oldest house in town.
gaps.explanation: point out = mention/draw attention to a fact.

gaps.sentence: I can't figure ___ how this app works.
Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
They worked ___ a compromise after hours of discussion.
gaps.explanation: work out = find the solution to; understand; also exercise.

gaps.sentence: Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!
The two founders hit it ___ immediately.
gaps.explanation: hit it off = like each other and become friendly quickly.

gaps.sentence: Her honesty more than makes ___ for her lack of experience.
gaps.explanation: 'Make up for' = compensate for a shortcoming.
